title: Zippers un-reliable; they 'split', get stuck, ...and vinyl material is too stiff & unpliable
text: Zippers un-reliable; they 'split', get stuck, ...and vinyl material is too stiff & unpliable. I was not satisfied with the quality of the bag for the price. I received it with a 'split' zipper, and I just felt the overall  quality of the bag was not up to the standards I'd expect for a rather pricey clear vinyl bag.
